description: 한국전자통신연구원_발음평가 기술 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 최신 인공지능 기술에 기반하여 한국인을 비롯한 비원어민 영어 발성 및 외국인의 한국어 음성에 대해 높은 정확도의 음성인식 엔진과 높은 수준의 분석 알고리즘에 기반하여 문장별 발음 수준을 측정하여 제공합니다. 발음평가 API는 HTTP 기반의 REST API 인터페이스로 JSON 포맷 기반의 입력 및 출력... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 발음평가, 음성분석, 인공지능, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
